messages:
olga.perez: Customer (AcmeEU) escalated a DPA question — they want authoritative evidence that all customer data for org_id=acme-881 was removed on 2026-11-30 and that KMS/HSM key material was never exported. They also asked for a subprocessor access log and proof backups were purged. Ticket DPA-8894. Can ops/security confirm steps to assemble the package?

mike_ops: Assigned. First pass: we need key usage entries (Cloud KMS / KMS audit), HSM attestation, object storage delete markers, and backup purge evidence. Do we have the delete job id?

olga.perez: Yes — delete job id is job_20261130_3345. Customer provided their original delete request timestamp as proof. They specifically asked for a signed statement about key export (or lack thereof).

raj.kumar: For the KMS/HSM side we can produce: 1) key usage audit (showing requests), 2) rotation records, 3) HSM vendor attestation that keys never left HSM. @sofia.liang can you pull key usage for alias `rwd-acme-881`?

sofia.liang: On it. Running the central audit query now: `SELECT * FROM key_usage WHERE key_alias='rwd-acme-881' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-12-01'` — will scrub ARNs and produce CSV. ETA ~30m.

ops-bot: Ticket DPA-8894 linked to incident INC-4521. Automated evidence export queued (job export_id=exp-7721).

sofia.liang: Quick paste of sanitized lines:
`2026-11-30T03:11:22Z    Encrypt    principal:svc-deleter    key:rwd-acme-881    request_id:abc123`
`2026-11-30T03:11:22Z    ScheduleDelete    principal:svc-deleter    job_id:job_20261130_3345    request_id:def456`
`2026-11-30T03:11:22Z    DestroyKeyMaterial    principal:kms-service    key:rwd-acme-881    outcome:ROTATED`
(Full CSV uploaded to secure share, see link below)

mike_ops: We also need object storage evidence — S3 bucket access logs / delete markers for `s3://redwood-prod-customer-data/acme-881` on 2026-11-30. Eng-infra / storage team: can you pull and redacted logs?

raj.kumar: Also collect subprocessor mapping (which third parties had access to that org) and their last access timestamps. I'll ping vendor-ops for last access.

sofia.liang: HSM note: vendor confirms keys are bound to HSM and never exported. I requested vendor attestation PDF (signed). Compliance will need to include that in the package.

compliance-bot: Reminder: EU DPA evidence must include chain-of-custody statement, CSV cross-reference (log ids -> file names), and a signed cover letter. Use template: /policies/dpa/evidence-template-v2.

olga.perez: Customer also asked for backup snapshot destruction proof. Who owns DB backups? @db_backup (please ack).

mike_ops: DB backups team owns it — tagging, also note we should include earliest retention policy and the actual deletion event for snapshots. We'll need snapshot IDs and deletion timestamps.

security_incident_bot: Security review required -> opened SEC-PR-118. Please fill assessment (sensitivity, scope, whether keys were re-used).

raj.kumar: Plan: I will gather subprocessors.csv + bucket logs. @sofia.liang please export the KMS CSV and include request IDs. Redact IPs and any internal ARNs.

sofia.liang: Export complete. Uploaded minimal sample and full secure export to: https://redwood-secure-shares/internal/acme-881/DPA-8894/ (internal link). Attached sample snippet above.

olga.perez: Thanks. After security/compliance signoff we'll produce a single signed ZIP for the customer. Target delivery: EOD PST or latest next business day.

mike_ops: Repro steps for internal reviewers — how we verified deletion:
```
# run delete job (as executed)
./run_delete --job-id job_20261130_3345 --env prod --confirm

# cloudtrail lookup example used to validate key activity
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=rwd-acme-881 --start-time 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z
```

olga.perez: I'll update the ticket DPA-8894 with the secure-share link and this thread summary. Once compliance + security sign, we'll send the package and close.

mike_ops: :lock: Final package will be archived, signed by security, and recorded in the DPA tracker (DPA-8894 -> evidence_id EVID-20261130-ACME).

compliance-bot: Compliance assigned to sofia.liang for review. Estimated review completion 2026-12-02T10:00:00Z UTC.

olga.perez: Great — thanks team. I'll follow up if customer requests additional notarized attestation.
